title: CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F(x)=f(x)+ψ(x) over a convex set Q. The function f is convex on the whole space, and ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer xstar∈Q exists; strong convexity is not assumed.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: objective; spec.admissible, ConvexOn assumptions and minimizer existence.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines a continuously differentiable convex term f with a potentially nonsmooth convex term ψ and a constraint Q, accessed through an exact quadratic proximal minimization oracle.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: A gradient query at any x returns ∇f(x) exactly, independently of query index and oracle seed. No function-value query is available.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: Query.gradient; spec.admissible, gradient-answer equality and HasGradientAt.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, a query (a,z,v) returns an exact minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Each gradient or proximal query counts as one oracle call; the budget is fixed and bounds calls for every seed.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: Query.prox; proxObjective; spec.admissible. LongTails/Template.lean: execute; Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only the real Hilbert space E, starting point x0, and positive initial scale h0 are public. L0,L1,R,Δ,G,ε are hidden; algorithm construction cannot depend on them, although the externally imposed oracle budget can.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: Public; Params; spec.publicInput; spec.valid. LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm and budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y,M, if ‖∇f(x+θ(y−x))‖≤M throughout θ∈[0,1], then ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Here L0>0 and L1≥0; the gradient is continuous. Global Lipschitz smoothness and twice differentiability are not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: spec.valid; spec.admissible, Continuous and segment-conditioned gradient inequality.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space, with no finite-dimensional restriction. The starting point lies in Q, and some minimizer satisfies ‖x0−xstar‖≤R, F(x0)−F(xstar)≤Δ, and ‖∇f(xstar)‖≤G, where R,Δ>0 and G≥0. The smooth-term gradient at the composite minimizer may be nonzero.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: Public.normedE, Public.linearE, Public.completeE; spec.valid; spec.admissible, final minimizer clause.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: For ε>0, the returned point must satisfy F(output)−F(xstar)≤ε for a minimizer xstar∈Q.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned point must belong to Q.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the ε objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law. Deterministic accuracy is not required by the specification.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree.lean: spec.successful, ∀ᵐ clause. LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, product probability measure.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This is a meaningful variant of convex composite optimization combining gradient-dependent segment smoothness, arbitrary Hilbert-space geometry, exact gradient and proximal access without function values, hidden problem parameters, and an almost-sure objective-gap guarantee under a fixed oracle budget.

descriptionHtml:
Parameter-Free Composite Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing F=f+ψ over a convex set Q in a real Hilbert space E, where f:E→R is convex and continuously differentiable and ψ:E→R is convex on Q. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth with hidden constants L0>0 and L1≥0. A given point x0∈Q has bounded distance and objective gap to a minimizer x⋆, whose smooth gradient is bounded. The oracle returns exact gradients and constrained proximal minimizers. For ε>0, the goal is x¯∈Q with F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

Write F(x)=f(x)+ψ(x). The optimization problem is minx∈QF(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ on E. The algorithm receives only E, x0, and a scalar h0>0; the parameters L0>0, L1≥0, R>0, Δ>0, G≥0, and ε>0 may enter only the oracle-call budget.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). The set Q⊆E is convex, f is convex on E, and ψ is convex on Q. Thus, for t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),x,y∈E,ψ((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)ψ(x)+tψ(y),x,y∈Q.

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E, and ∇f:E→E is continuous. For every x,y∈E and M∈R, the segment bound ∥∇f(x+t(y−x))∥≤Mfor every t∈[0,1] implies ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Exact proximal minimization). There is a map P:R×E×E→E such that, for every a>0 and z,v∈E, P(a,z,v)∈argminu∈Q{∥u−z∥22a+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u)}.

Assumption 4 (Initial point and minimizer). The given point satisfies x0∈Q. There exists x⋆∈Q such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈Q,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ,∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G.

The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. A proximal query (a,z,v) returns P(a,z,v). Gradient queries may use any x∈E, and proximal queries may use any a∈R and z,v∈E; the proximal minimization condition applies when a>0. Both query types count toward a single total oracle-call budget.

After the allotted calls, the output must satisfy x¯∈Q,F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤εP-a.s. The minimizer x⋆ is fixed independently of the algorithm’s randomness.

comparisonHtml:
Minimize F=f+ψ over convex Q in a real Hilbert space. The function f is convex with continuous gradient and satisfies ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥ whenever ∥∇f(z)∥≤M on [x,y]; ψ is finite-valued and convex on Q. Exact gradients and minimizers of ψ(u)+⟨v,u−z⟩+∥u−z∥2/(2a) over u∈Q are available for every a>0,z,v. There is a minimizer x⋆∈Q with x0∈Q, ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ, and ∥∇f(x⋆)∥≤G. Here L0,R,Δ,h0,ε>0 and L1,G≥0. Target: deterministic x^∈Q with F(x^)−F(x⋆)≤ε. The constructed method receives only (x0,h0); its stopping budget depends on all setup parameters.

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function
import LongTails.Template

open Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  x0 : E
  h0 : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE Public.completeE

structure Params extends Public where
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

inductive Query (p : Public) where
  | gradient (x : p.E)
  | prox (a : ℝ) (z v : p.E)

structure Instance (p : Public) where
  f : p.E → ℝ
  ψ : p.E → ℝ
  Q : Set p.E
  grad : p.E → p.E
  prox : ℝ → p.E → p.E → p.E

noncomputable def objective {p : Public} (I : Instance p) (x : p.E) : ℝ := I.f x + I.ψ x

noncomputable def proxObjective {p : Public} (I : Instance p) (a : ℝ) (z v u : p.E) : ℝ :=
  ‖u - z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * a) + ⟪v, u - z⟫ + I.ψ u

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.h0 ∧ 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ q.G ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q I oracle :=
    (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, (.gradient x)) seed = I.grad x) ∧
    (∀ k seed a z v, oracle.answer k (0, (.prox a z v)) seed = I.prox a z v) ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ univ I.f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt I.f (I.grad x) x) ∧
    Continuous I.grad ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖I.grad (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖I.grad x - I.grad y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    Convex ℝ I.Q ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.ψ ∧
    (∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ z v, I.prox a z v ∈ I.Q ∧
      IsMinOn (proxObjective I a z v) I.Q (I.prox a z v)) ∧
    q.x0 ∈ I.Q ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      objective I q.x0 - objective I xstar ≤ q.Δ ∧ ‖I.grad xstar‖ ≤ q.G)
  successful q I output P :=
    ∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _),
        output ω ∈ I.Q ∧ objective I (output ω) - objective I xstar ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.CompositeGeneralizedParameterFree
